title: Query the Library
description: Using the Book model, write queries to find books published after 2000, update a book's title, and delete a book.
problemStatement:
## Your Mission

Assuming you have the `Book` model from Task 1 and some books already in the database, write Python code to perform the following operations:

1. Retrieve all books published after the year 2000.
2. Change the title of the book with ISBN '978-3-16-148410-0' to 'New Title'.
3. Delete all books with the author 'John Doe'.

Write the code as you would in the Django shell (`python manage.py shell`).
hints: Use `get(isbn='...')` to retrieve a specific book, then assign `book.title = 'New Title'` and `book.save()`.
Use `filter(author='John Doe').delete()` to delete all matching books.
expectedOutput: No specific output – the queries should execute without errors. In the shell, you'll see the results when you print them.
solutionCode:
# In Django shell
from library.models import Book

# 1. Books after 2000
books_after_2000 = Book.objects.filter(published_year__gt=2000)
print(books_after_2000)

# 2. Update title
book = Book.objects.get(isbn='978-3-16-148410-0')
book.title = 'New Title'
book.save()

# 3. Delete John Doe's books
Book.objects.filter(author='John Doe').delete()
